newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.

LIVE CATTLE - steady. Trade expected to be quiet ahead of key USDA cattle-on-feed and cattle inventory reports to be issued later Friday. Rolling of positions out of August into October may be the main feature. Little trade expected in the cash market.

FEEDER CATTLE - 0.10 to 0.20 cent lower. Overnight gains in CBOT corn may give the market a weaker tone early. The cash feeder market, however, remains very strong while technically the outlook also appears bullish.

LEAN HOGS - 0.10 to 0.20 cent lower. Cash hogs expected to be steady to $0.50 lower Friday and may weaken further early next week with talk of a light kill Monday while forecasts for cooler temperatures should lead to a pick-up in runs.
PORK BELLIES - 0.50 to 1.00 cent higher. Cash fresh belly market remains very strong. Follow-through buying likely after August ended locked limit up on Thursday.
